entries.english: Correspondence of Prince Emil with private individuals, letter R. Contents: von Ragenau, Darmstadt; Radetzky, Feldmarschall, Milan; von Rathsamhausen, Freifrau, Darmstadt; Rechberg, Frankfurt; Renaud, Generalvikar, Lyon; Fanny von Renneville, Darmstadt; Toustair, Richebourg/St. Martin; members of the Barons von Riedesel family; [La] Rochefoucauld, Darmstadt; Röder, Darmstadt; Roquet, Generalleutnant; von Rosenberg; Rossi, Frankfurt am Main; Rostaing, Montbreton; Rothschild, Frankfurt am Main.
